name: companion-web-dashboard
description: Web-based dashboard for Bitfocus Companion variables

scripts.install:all: npm install && cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install && cd ../electron && npm install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix client && npm run build --prefix server
scripts.mac:dev: npm run build && cd electron && npm start
scripts.mac:pack: npm run build && cd server && npm prune --omit=dev && cd ../electron && npm run pack
scripts.mac:build: npm run build && cd server && npm prune --omit=dev && cd ../electron && npm run dist:mac
scripts.mac:build:signed: npm run build && cd server && npm prune --omit=dev && cd ../electron && npm run dist:mac:signed
scripts.win:build: npm run build && cd server && npm prune --omit=dev && cd ../electron && npm run dist:win
scripts.release:all: npm run build && cd server && npm prune --omit=dev && cd ../electron && npm run dist:all
